scope: The timber twin-porch and central-gable Cloncurry Post Office around 1910, after its 1906 construction. Includes the raised original office, verandahs, steps and corrugated hip roof. The separate postmaster’s residence and later exchange additions are outside this historical exterior.

references.filename: Stagecoach outside the post and telegraph office in Cloncurry, ca. 1910.tif

originalReview.notes: The original TIFF is published under a .jpg path in Qualla but its native bytes match exactly. The office has horizontal timber boards, a central projecting gable, slatted upper gable, a shuttered front window, raised open porches and a corrugated hip roof. A tear and stagecoach obscure parts of the lower front.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed the two Qualla archive originals first. Selected the exact 1910 State Library of Queensland original with its native expiry grant, supported by the library’s own catalog caption and identifier. The 1935 photograph is outside the selected era. No supplemental imagery was used.
